programme.title: Do You Take This Man

programme.title: Elvis & Madona
programme.desc: Elvis & Madona is a romantic comedy that deals with an unusual subject in a delicate and realistic way: a love story between young lesbian Elvis and a transvestite Madona. The story takes place in Copacabana, neighborhood in Rio de Janeiro. The screenplay comprehends a full array of human types and, by following the journey of both protagonists, illustrates the conflicts generated by the evolution of behavior and custom. It is a modern and agile picture, and its soundtrack will follow the latest musical trends. Nevertheless, it is essentially a love story, proving that love can exist in any situation.

programme.title: The Dream Children
programme.desc: Alex wants to become a father. Steven, his partner, has to confront his insecurities and fear of change after a lifetime smothered by superficiality. Unable to adopt legally, but still eager to become parents, they decide to turn to the black market, adopting a child from a desperate young woman, who's return with a dangerous new boyfriend, threatens to destroy everything they love.

programme.title: Zoltan Kaszas
programme.desc: Zoltan Kaszas was born in Budapest, Hungary and raised in San Diego, California. He first stepped onstage at the age of nineteen and he was hooked immediately. Zoltan's diverse background and life experience along with his conversational storytelling style has been entertaining audiences at comedy clubs and colleges across the country. His comedy has also been featured on the television show Laughs on FOX, on radio at SiriusXM in print in The Atlantic and has helped him win The Seattle International Comedy Competition &The San Diego Comedy Festival. When he isn't traveling the world Zoltan can be found at home with his wife Brittany and their cat Jessica, you can keep up with him on his weekly podcast available on iTunes called This Week In Zoltan.

programme.title: Brian Moote
programme.desc: Brian Moote started performing stand up in 2005 while he was working as a teacher in the Seattle School District. He then went to graduate school to get a masters degree in social work because who doesn't love crippling debt? I mean, this is America. After graduating he moved to LA and now tours the country telling jokes. He has made TV appearances on the USA Network's "Characters Welcome," Nickelodeon's "Nickmom's Nite Out," MTV's "Money from Strangers" and AXS TV's "Gotham Live." You should come out and see him tell jokes... DO IT!!!

programme.title: Mike Speenberg
programme.desc: Mike Speenberg has been a professional touring Stand-up comedian for 20 years. He's performed on 5 different continents, entertained everyone from Hall of Fame Athletes to US Diplomats, shared the stage with everyone from Robin Williams to Bill Burr, and been featured on everything from CNN to the AMERICAN FORCES RADIO NETWORK.

programme.title: Andrew Rivers
programme.desc: Andrew's very personal and fun storytelling comedy, combined with his exemplary work ethic has earned him high praise from some of the best comedians in the business. Andrew is a featured writer, actor, and comedian on the TV show “UpLate NW.” Andrew has been featured on NBC, FOX, and the Bob & Tom Radio Show and is a regular opening act for Christopher Titus. Andrew was also featured on the popular Buzzfeed web series “Truth or Drink“, has performed in over 35 states and his new podcast called “Don't Quit Your Night Job” was featured in the Seattle Times.

programme.title: Collin Moulton
programme.desc: Collin is one of the most fun, personable, and sought after headliners today. He has had his own stand-up special on SHOWTIME, he's been on NICKELODEON, and was recently featured on LAST CALL WITH CARSON DALY. Touring for over 15 years Collin has gained an ease and enjoyment on stage that makes every show worth watching.America knows and loves him. His familiarity and energy engages and relieves the audience before he even speaks. His electric storytelling style makes you care about every topic he explores. Collin's comedy is the release needed from our every day lives. Come needing to laugh tonight, leave wanting to laugh forever!Collin Moulton

programme.title: Costaki Economopoulos
programme.desc: For 20 years Costaki has been living his dream as a full-time stand up comic. He has written jokes for Bette Midler, Jay Leno, MTV, and BET. You may have seen him on Showtime or heard him on Sirius, but you probably know him best from his regular appearances on the nationally syndicated Bob & Tom Radio Show.

programme.title: Tim Young
programme.desc: Tim headlines clubs all over North America, has performed on over 500 college campuses as well as comedy festivals in New York, Montreal, and Seattle, and he's a fixture in the New York City club scene. He was a finalist on NBCs Last Comic Standing, has appeared on Comedy Centrals Premium Blend, Tough Crowd, and Shorties, and you may have seen him as a commentator on VH1, MTV, TLC and the E! Channel.

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 2004, Rebecca Barney and her soon-to-be ex-husband Fred were found shot to death in their Tulsa, Oklahoma, home, which had been set on fire.

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A security guard disappeared from his post without a trace; his remains were found a year later in a remote campsite.

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: RiffTrax: Swamp Of The Ravens
programme.desc: The stars of Mystery Science Theater 3000 bring their comedic riffing treatment to this utterly baffling horror classic about a mad doctor who believes death is simply an evolution and that every woman wants to sleep with him.

programme.title: RiffTrax: Max Havoc - Ring of Fire
programme.desc: Cash should have trademarked Ring of Fire to prevent this from happening. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

programme.title: RiffTrax: Maximum Revenge
programme.desc: This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from RiffTrax (formerly of MST3K).

programme.title: RiffTrax Live: Space Mutiny
programme.desc: Space Mutiny! The very title conjures up many memories: tiny cars, writhing spandex witches, deadly railings. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin, and Bill from MST3K.

programme.title: RiffTrax: Terror at Tenkiller
programme.desc: Follow-up to the rarely seen, totally imaginary films Ennui at Eightkiller and Nausea at Ninekiller, Terror at Tenkiller really brings the goods! And by “the goods” we mostly mean there’s a character named Tor in it.

programme.title: RiffTrax Short: Overcoming Fear
programme.desc: Fear: Most of us rejected it in the mid-90s by wearing trendy t-shirts emblazoned with slogans such as "Second Place is the First Loser."

programme.title: RiffTrax Shorts: Six Murderous Beliefs
programme.desc: These beliefs are bad, and not just “the Tim Burton Planet of the Apes is the best version” bad. They're seriously bad. This short is a parody and contains a comedic commentary by RiffTrax.

programme.title: RiffTrax Shorts: People Soup
programme.desc: Seemingly shot without a script or purpose, People Soup gives hope to the maker of every pointless educational short that your efforts will one day be rewarded with critical acclaim. This short is a parody and contains a comedic commentary by RiffTrax.

programme.title: Rifftrax Shorts: Measuring Man
programme.desc: From the stars of Mystery Science Theater 3000 comes the comedic genius known as Rifftrax!

programme.title: RiffTrax Short: A Visit to Santa
programme.desc: Just in time for the holidays, RiffTrax presents our take on A Visit to Santa, a Christmas short of unknown origin that most probably was the result of Santa's short-lived collaboration with the producing team of Screwtape and Wormwood.

programme.title: RiffTrax: Merlin The Return
programme.desc: Merlin, the legendary wizard is stuck inside a terrible nether dimension. Meanwhile, the former stars of Wayne's World, Highlander, and The Young Ones are stuck in a terrible movie about Merlin, the legendary wizard.

programme.title: RiffTrax: Universal Soldier III: Unfinished Business
programme.desc: Things explode! Robots wear Google Glass! Business… gets finished?? This feature is a parody with the original movie & funny commentary with Mike, Kevin & Bill of MST3K.

programme.title: Willy's Wonderland
programme.desc: Un conserje acepta limpiar el abandonado parque de atracciones Willy’s Wonderland, pero descubre que sus inquietantes personajes están malditos. Atrapado durante la noche, deberá enfrentarse a ellos en una brutal lucha por la supervivencia llena de acción, humor y terror.

programme.title: Feriados
programme.desc: ¿Cuál es el significado de la vida cuando estás en tus 30? Un grupo de amigos y conocidos treintañeros buscan respuestas en su cambiante vida adulta: relación, carrera, familia. Ambientada en fechas importantes, cada episodio marca un cambio en su vida y en su búsqueda de la felicidad; comienzan algo, terminan algo o reconsideran su perspectiva de la vida.

programme.title: Nivel 16
programme.desc: Thriller distópico sobre una academia que adoctrina a adolescentes imponiendo la pasividad como virtud. Vivien, de 16 años, está atrapada en la Academia Vestalis, un internado que parece una prisión. Su vida cambia al reencontrarse con Sophia, una antigua amiga que la traicionó. Juntas descubren la verdad tras su encarcelamiento y luchan por sobrevivir y escapar.

programme.title: El almirante: Mar de fuego
programme.desc: Basada en la legendaria Batalla de Myeongnyang. En 1597, durante la invasión japonesa de Corea, el almirante Yi Sun-Shin se enfrenta con solo 12 barcos y una tripulación inexperta a una flota japonesa de más de 300 navíos. Tras la destrucción del Barco Tortuga, última esperanza de Joseon, deberá usar su ingenio y valentía para cambiar el curso de la guerra.

programme.title: La leyenda de Hei
programme.desc: En el bullicioso mundo de los humanos, varios duendes viven en paz con la humanidad hasta que el mundo en el que viven empieza a ser perturbado por la gente.

programme.title: Donkey Xote
programme.desc: El burro Rucio, compañero de Sancho Panza, decide contar la historia de Don Quijote. De hecho, Rucio insiste en que el caballero no es tan loco y extravagante como muchos piensan.

programme.title: Feriados
programme.desc: ¿Cuál es el significado de la vida cuando estás en tus 30? Un grupo de amigos y conocidos treintañeros buscan respuestas en su cambiante vida adulta: relación, carrera, familia. Ambientada en fechas importantes, cada episodio marca un cambio en su vida y en su búsqueda de la felicidad; comienzan algo, terminan algo o reconsideran su perspectiva de la vida.

programme.title: Irresistible
programme.desc: Sophie Hartley (Susan Sarandon), una exitosa ilustradora de Melbourne, está convencida de que alguien la acecha. Sospecha que Mara (Emily Blunt), una compañera de trabajo de su marido (Sam Neil), quiere quitarle a sus hijos, a su marido e incluso matarla, pero nadie la cree.

programme.title: Sobreviviendo en Marte
programme.desc: Tras un desastre ecológico, una familia sobrevive en un Marte desolado. Cuando unos bandidos atacan su hogar y matan al padre, solo Ilsa y su hija Remmy logran sobrevivir. Uno de los asaltantes exige quedarse con ellas durante treinta días para demostrar su valía. Madre e hija deberán decidir si pueden confiar en él mientras luchan por sobrevivir en un entorno hostil.

programme.title: Historia de una traición
programme.desc: Basada en hechos reales, Mildred Gillars, conocida como “Axis Sally”, es obligada por los nazis a emitir propaganda para soldados estadounidenses durante la II Guerra Mundial. Tras su relación con Goebbels y su posterior arresto, es juzgada por traición con la ayuda de su abogado defensor.

programme.title: La Cornisa
programme.desc: Tras haber tenido un tórrido romance con la mujer de un vecino (Liv Tyler), Gavin (Charlie Hunnam) está en la cornisa de un edificio de gran altura con la intención de saltar al vacío antes de mediodía. Un policía (Terrence Howard) intentará por todos los medios manejar la situación e impedir el suicidio de Gavin. 2011: Festival de Sundance, Nominada al Gran Premio del Jurado

programme.title: LMN's
programme.desc: Chip es un niño de 9 años que prefiere jugar con sus compañeros antes de las clases de física y química con su maestra Susan. Un día, durante una visita escolar al Instituto de Alta Energía, un científico loco, el Dr. No, está realizando un experimento con una lente capaz de convertir materia en antimateria, lo que provoca un accidente y un rayo incontrolado que lanza a Chip y al científico a la dimensión del micromundo. Chip se da cuenta de que el accidente lo ha enviado a un lugar desconocido y no sabe cómo regresar. Unos átomos de hierro, mercurio e hidrógeno, representados como Fer, Merc e Hidro, lo guiarán para ayudarlo a encontrar el camino de vuelta. Al mismo tiempo, el Dr. No descubre que, debido al accidente, ha logrado crear antimateria, y el poder que esto le otorga lo prepara para convertirse en el amo del mundo.

programme.title: LMN's
programme.desc: Fer, Merc e Hidro llevan a Chip a la Ciudad Atómica, donde hay noticias de otro humano, el Dr. No, que ha llegado al micromundo. Chip piensa que tal vez el Dr. No podría ayudarlo a regresar a su dimensión, y va a verlo para devolverle la lente que el científico perdió durante el viaje al micromundo. Pero el Dr. No está construyendo la Torre Negra, una poderosa máquina que lo ayudará a esclavizar a todos los átomos del micromundo. Ahora tiene muchos trabajando bajo sus órdenes, y los lanza contra Chip y sus amigos para convertirlos en prisioneros y arrebatarles la lente. Al escapar, Chip cae en una corriente eléctrica que lo transporta muy lejos.
